# proxmox_user_tfa_unlock (Resource)

Clears the TFA lockout of one user through `PUT /access/users/{userid}/unlock-tfa`. Proxmox locks users after too many failed second factors; the lock also clears automatically after a timeout. Every change replaces the instance and unlocks again; destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_user_tfa_unlock" "root" {
  user_id  = "root@pam"
  triggers = { reason = "manual" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to unlock again; changing any of them unlocks again.
- `user_id` (String) User in `name@realm` form. Changes require replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User identifier.
- `unlocked` (Boolean) Whether Proxmox reported the unlock as successful.
